content: Azure Workload Center for Oracle, together with the Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent, is a workload-aware experience, powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI) for operating Oracle workloads on Azure. Azure Workload Center for Oracle helps teams understand workload health, identify configuration deviations, and assess the impact of platform issues in the context of the applications they support. Each workload is represented as a Workload Virtual Instance (WVI), bringing architecture, dependencies, metadata, and operational context into a single view. Workload-specific details, such as Oracle system identifiers (SIDs) and production designations, help teams and AI agents understand each environment in context, while Azure Monitor health models provide health insights across application, database, and infrastructure layers. Customers can discover and onboard workloads, validate configurations against workload-specific best practices, detect deviations, monitor health, troubleshoot issues, and take guided remediation actions. Purpose-built AI agents help operators understand what changed, assess impact, and identify recommended next steps while keeping teams in control of decisions and remediation. Availability: Australia East, Central US, East US, East US 2, Germany West Central, Italy North, Japan East, Korea Central, North Europe, South Central US.
